
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/liuyangjava/p/19725853" title="发布于 2026-03-16 17:25">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Caused by: org.jasypt.exceptions.EncryptionOperationNotPossibleException: Encryption raised an exception</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>今天在项目中作加密配置后，启动应用出现如下的问题：</p>
<p>Caused by: org.jasypt.exceptions.EncryptionOperationNotPossibleException: Encryption raised an exception. A possible cause is you are using strong encryption algorithms and you have not installed the Java Cryptography Extension (JCE) Unlimited Strength Jurisdiction Policy Files in this Java Virtual Machine</p>
<p>原因：这个错误提示您使用的是高强度加密算法，但Java环境缺少JCE无限强度策略文件</p>
<p>解决办法可以采用两种方式</p>
<p>第一种方法：下载对应的JDK版本的JCE无限制强度策略文件</p>
<p>安装配置步骤</p>
<ul>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul">
<p>下载后解压，您会得到两个JAR文件：<code class="hyc-common-markdown__code__inline">local_policy.jar</code>和 <code class="hyc-common-markdown__code__inline">US_export_policy.jar</code></p>
</li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul">
<p>找到您的JRE安装目录下的安全策略文件夹：</p>
<ul class="ybc-ul-component">
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul">
<p>Windows: <code class="hyc-common-markdown__code__inline">%JAVA_HOME%\jre\lib\security</code></p>
</li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul">
<p>Linux/Mac: <code class="hyc-common-markdown__code__inline">$JAVA_HOME/jre/lib/security</code></p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul">
<p>备份原有的策略文件</p>
</li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul">
<p>将下载的两个JAR文件复制到该目录，覆盖原有文件</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>第二种方法：从Java 9开始，JCE无限强度策略文件已经是标准配置，不再需要单独安装。</p>
<p><strong>Java 9及以上</strong>（包括Java 11, 17, 21等）：</p>
<ul>
<li style="list-style-type: none">
<ul class="ybc-ul-component">
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul">
<p>无限强度加密算法<strong>默认启用</strong></p>
</li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul">
<p>JCE策略文件<strong>已内置</strong>在JDK中</p>
</li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul">
<p>不再需要单独下载和安装</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>升级到Java 11+的好处：</strong></p>
<ul class="ybc-ul-component">
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul">
<p>✅ 无需处理JCE策略文件问题</p>
</li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul">
<p>✅ 长期支持版本（LTS）更新周期更长</p>
</li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul">
<p>✅ 性能提升和新特性</p>
</li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul">
<p>✅ 安全性改进</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>推荐的Java 11+版本：</strong></p>
<ul class="ybc-ul-component">
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul">
<p><strong>Java 11 LTS</strong>：目前仍广泛使用</p>
</li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul">
<p><strong>Java 17 LTS</strong>：推荐的稳定版本</p>
</li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul">
<p><strong>Java 21 LTS</strong>：最新长期支持版</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>推荐大家收藏保留</p>

</div>
